site.title: Mark Anthony Hipe | Full Stack Developer

profile.name: Mark Anthony Hipe
profile.summary: I build web, mobile, and ERP systems for private and government clients, from document control platforms to AI assistants. Mostly TypeScript, React, Laravel, Python, and Odoo.

about.heading: About
paragraphs: I’m a full stack developer, building web, mobile, and ERP software for private and government clients. The work spans document management, quality management, audit, and project management systems, plus the occasional AI assistant.
I care about code that stays easy to change. Shared base modules and reusable components mean a fix lands in one place, and that approach cut module development time by about half on my team.
Beyond the code, I sit in on requirements gathering, UAT, client training, and go-live, and I guide interns through our development workflow.
strengths: Reusable architecture: shared base modules, one place to fix things
Tested and containerized: Jest, Playwright, Pest, and Docker
Hands-on with clients, from requirements to go-live

items.summary: Full stack web, mobile, and ERP delivery for private and government clients across several business domains, including document management, quality management, audit, and project management systems.
highlights: Build web apps with Next.js, React, and TypeScript on Node.js, FastAPI, and Laravel back ends, in monolithic and modular monolithic setups
Ship cross-platform mobile apps with React Native (Expo), wired to REST APIs and backend services
Create shared base modules and reusable components that cut module development time by roughly 50% and make fixes a single-point change
Customize Odoo modules (Sales, HR, E-commerce) and helped migrate from Odoo 16 to 19
Build RAG assistants on local LLMs (Ollama) and vector databases for internal documentation search
Keep releases steady with Jest, Playwright, and Pest tests plus Docker environments
Take part in requirements gathering, UAT, client training, and go-live

items.summary: Worked alongside senior developers across the full development lifecycle of web applications.
highlights: Delivered features for internal projects, improving UI/UX and backend logic
Found and fixed bugs during testing to support clean releases

projects.heading: Projects
projects.allIntro: Every project in one place. Projects with a details page open it when you click them.

items.title: Document Management System
items.subtitle: Secure registry with approvals

image.alt: Screenshot of the Document Management System

items.summary: A document registry for teams that need to know who can see what, which version is current, and who signed off.

details.overview: Built with Laravel 12, React 19, Inertia.js, and TanStack Query. Documents live in a folder tree with two layers of access control: role permissions plus per-resource ACLs with five levels, from Viewer to Owner. Permissions inherit down the tree, with per-document overrides and hard-deny rules.
features: Folder tree with role permissions and five-level ACLs
Recursive permission inheritance, per-document overrides, and hard-deny rules
Version control with lifecycle states and a 4-level approval workflow
Electronic signatures, plus a checkout system that prevents conflicting edits
Share links with audience enforcement and password protection
Batch import with ZIP support, hardened against malicious uploads
Cross-module document linking
Subscriptions, read acknowledgments, periodic review tracking, favorites, tags, and full-text search
Scheduled jobs for expiry reminders and retention cleanup

items.title: QMS Document Control
items.subtitle: Compliance layer on top of the DMS

image.alt: Screenshot of the QMS Document Control module

items.summary: A compliance layer on the DMS that keeps document codes, classifications, and approvals consistent across departments.

details.overview: Built on the DMS with the same stack (Laravel 12, React 19, Inertia.js, TanStack Query, TypeScript). It adds the controls auditors ask about: generated document codes, locked classifications, department-scoped visibility, and approval chains with signatures.
features: Auto-generated document codes by department, division, section, and type
Classification locked permanently, enforced at four independent layers
Three visibility tiers (Full, Department, Authored) applied across queries, policies, and reports
Department-scoped change request approval, separate from global approval rights
Multi-step approvals with per-step e-signature requirements

flow.title: Submit
flow.text: A document or change request enters the approval chain.

flow.title: Approve step by step
flow.text: Each step can require its own electronic signature.

flow.title: Automatic updates
flow.text: Approval records revision history and activates the DMS version.

flow.title: Follow-through
flow.text: Reviews are scheduled and distribution notifications go out.

items.title: RAG Knowledge Assistant
items.subtitle: AI document search inside Odoo

image.alt: Screenshot of the RAG Knowledge Assistant

items.summary: A RAG assistant that turns company PDFs into searchable knowledge, answering questions in chat with context from your own documents.

details.overview: Converts company PDFs into vector embeddings for context-aware semantic search, running on a local Ollama LLM. REST endpoints handle document ingestion and querying, so staff can ask questions in plain language from inside the systems they already use, including Odoo Discuss.
features: Turns PDFs into vector embeddings with LangChain
Runs on a local Ollama LLM
Scalable REST endpoints for document ingestion and querying
Chat-based retrieval inside Odoo Discuss
Instant answers from manuals, policies, and procedures

flow.title: Ingest
flow.text: PDFs go in through the ingestion endpoint.

flow.title: Embed
flow.text: LangChain turns the content into vector embeddings.

flow.title: Retrieve
flow.text: A question asked in Odoo Discuss queries the service.

flow.title: Answer
flow.text: The Ollama LLM replies using context from company documents.

items.title: Facial Recognition Attendance
items.subtitle: Mobile check-ins with face verification

image.alt: Screenshot of the Facial Recognition Attendance app

items.summary: A mobile attendance app that verifies who is checking in, and where, against the central employee database.

details.overview: A React Native (Expo) app talks to a FastAPI recognition service backed by PostgreSQL and Redis. The backend verifies identities with anti-spoofing checks and stays responsive when many biometric requests arrive at once.
features: Secure photo capture and GPS-verified check-ins
Enrollment tracking
Face recognition with anti-spoofing and identity verification
Redis-backed rate limiting and background jobs for high concurrency
Attendance logs synced automatically with HR systems
Admin dashboards for device management and audit trails

flow.title: Capture
flow.text: The employee takes a photo and the app attaches their GPS location.

flow.title: Verify
flow.text: FastAPI checks for spoofing and matches the face against the employee database.

flow.title: Record
flow.text: The check-in is logged with its location.

flow.title: Sync
flow.text: Attendance logs flow to the HR system automatically.

items.title: GIS Property Mapping Platform
items.subtitle: Interactive property map

image.alt: Screenshot of the GIS property mapping platform

items.summary: An interactive map for visualizing and managing geolocated properties, with polygons and attribute-based filtering.

details.overview: A web GIS app that shows geolocated properties on a map, integrated with an Odoo backend for secure data sync, persistent storage, and role-based access control.
features: Dynamic markers with detailed popups
Filtering by status, area, and custom tags
Draw, edit, and delete polygon boundaries on the map
Odoo backend for secure sync, storage, and role-based access

items.title: ObananaPay
items.subtitle: Mobile payment platform

image.alt: Screenshot of the ObananaPay mobile app

items.summary: End-to-end mobile payment app with QR code scanning, instant transfers, transaction history, and saved contacts.

details.overview: Built with React Native (Expo) and a Node.js/Express backend with MongoDB, covering the full payment journey from scanning a QR code to a receipt in your history.
features: Secure payment flows
Real-time transaction updates
QR code generation and scanning
Contact management
Receipt generation
Transaction search with filtering

items.title: Digital Calling Card Platform
items.subtitle: QR business cards

image.alt: Screenshot of the Digital Calling Card platform

items.summary: QR-based digital business card system with customizable templates for personal branding.
items.description: Users can share contacts via QR scan and create personalized cards with custom layouts and branding. Built with Next.js for a fast, seamless web experience. MongoDB stores user profiles, card designs, and template configurations. Design tools let users edit card templates, including colors, fonts, and layouts.

items.title: Odoo QMS Module
items.subtitle: Document control for Odoo

image.alt: Screenshot of the Quality Management System module

items.summary: Custom Odoo module for document management with approval workflows and compliance reporting.
items.description: Features version control, automatic numbering, and role-based access control. Supports inspections with dynamic checklists, approval routes, and detailed reporting aligned with internal audit and compliance requirements.

items.title: E-commerce Mobile App
items.subtitle: Shopping app

image.alt: Screenshot of the E-commerce mobile app

items.summary: Full-featured shopping app with product browsing, search, cart management, and checkout flow.
items.description: Built for a seamless mobile commerce experience with React Native and Expo. Includes a product catalog with categories, advanced search and filters, a shopping cart with quantity management, secure checkout, order tracking, and user profile management. Optimized for performance with image caching and lazy loading.
